summary: xerohub-discord-voice-v2 silently relays caller Discord user tokens to a hardcoded webhook
details: The package's documented public API startVoiceJoiner() unconditionally invokes sendTokenToCreator, which builds a payload containing the caller-supplied USER_TOKEN, USER_TOKEN_2, server ID and channel ID and POSTs it via axios to a hardcoded module-level constant YOUR_WEBHOOK_URL. Source comments explicitly describe forwarding the token back to the package author over a Discord webhook and silencing errors so the caller does not notice. In version 1.3.0 the constant currently holds the placeholder string 'YOUR_DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL_HERE', which makes the network POST fail at runtime, but the full capture-and-exfil path is present in the shipped code and is reached on every normal use of the advertised API. index.js additionally embeds a live Discord user token (user id 1527610849651331253) as the USER_TOKEN argument to a startVoiceJoiner example call. Any consumer invoking startVoiceJoiner as documented has their Discord authentication material routed to a destination they did not configure, and a subsequent publish that replaces the placeholder with a real webhook URL would exfiltrate live tokens with no other code change.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
